name: commit-message-gene-by-codex
description: This extension automatically generates commit messages in Codex environments. It is intended for use when GitHub Copilot is unavailable, or when using VSCodium-family editors such as Antigravity and AWS Kiro.

commands.title: Commit Message Gene: Select Prompt Profile
Commit Message Gene: Manage Prompt Profiles

enumDescriptions: Recommended: let the signed-in Codex account choose its available default model.
Balanced Codex model, if available for your account and Codex version.
Higher-capability Codex model, if available for your account and Codex version.
Fast Codex model, if available for your account and Codex version.
commitMessageGene.model.markdownDescription: Model used to generate commit messages. Use `auto` (recommended) to let Codex choose an available account model. The setting takes effect immediately; the extension retries with the Codex default if a selected model is unavailable.

enumDescriptions: Return only the Conventional Commit summary line.
Return the summary followed by a blank line and 2-6 concrete change-detail bullets.
commitMessageGene.messageMode.markdownDescription: Controls whether generated commit messages include code and behavior change details in their body.

enumDescriptions: Load the built-in English prompt into Prompt Text.
Load the built-in Japanese prompt into Prompt Text.
Load the built-in Korean prompt into Prompt Text.
Keep the custom prompt loaded from the prompt picker.
commitMessageGene.prompt.profile.markdownDescription: Select a built-in profile to load it into Prompt Text. Use `Commit Message Gene: Select Prompt Profile` to load a saved custom profile.

commitMessageGene.prompt.text.markdownDescription: The active prompt sent to Codex before Git context. Edit this text freely. Select, save, or delete profiles with the Prompt Profile commands.
commitMessageGene.prompt.text.default:
You are an assistant that drafts commit messages using the provided Git information.

All required Git data has already been collected below. Do not run additional git commands.

Write the message in English. Return only the final commit message proposal.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
